title: FMEA: Cell Voltage Acquisition and Protection Chain

revision_history.author: safety_engineer
revision_history.description: Initial synthetic FMEA for cell voltage chain

scope: Cell voltage acquisition, plausibility, SOA monitoring, contactor control (synthetic_reference profile)
method: Bottom-up inductive analysis (ISO 26262-9:7.4.2 methodology). Illustrative severity/occurrence/detection ratings; no supplier reliability data used.

failure_modes.failure_mode: Cell voltage value corrupted during SPI transmission
failure_modes.failure_effect: SOA evaluation on wrong voltage; overvoltage undetected (HE-01) or false fault
failure_modes.residual_risk: ASIL_D path additionally covered by independent monitor (FB2-SAF-FSR-000004)

failure_modes.failure_mode: SOA check task delayed beyond 50 ms period (starvation)
failure_modes.cause: CPU overload, priority inversion, blocking driver call

mechanisms.name: Fixed-priority preemptive scheduling (SOA highest app priority)

failure_modes.residual_risk: Independent HW monitor covers 50 ms window (FB2-HW-TSR-000004)

failure_modes.failure_mode: Contactor opening command not executed (welded main contactor)
failure_modes.failure_effect: Safe state not reachable despite correct detection (HE-03)
failure_modes.cause: Contact welding due to inrush current, mechanical wear

mechanisms.name: Contactor feedback monitoring (aux contacts, current sense)

failure_modes.residual_risk: Weld detection alerts driver; vehicle-level safe stop out of BMS scope (assumption ASM-006)

failure_modes.failure_effect: Availability loss; no direct safety hazard
failure_modes.cause: Comparator threshold drift, reference voltage noise

mechanisms.name: Monitor threshold above main path warning (hysteresis)

failure_modes.residual_risk: Accepted: fail-safe direction (spurious open) per FSR-000004

failure_modes.failure_mode: Stale cell voltage read by SOA (freshness > 30 ms)
failure_modes.failure_effect: Delayed overvoltage detection; FTTI budget consumed

mechanisms.name: Freshness timestamp check in SOA read

failure_modes.residual_risk: None identified; freshness fault triggers derating state
